skills.description: Upscale a finished clip to 1080p, 2K or 4K with Sloosh and state the delivery specs, through the Video Upscale Space or a canvas upscale node with FLUX or Topaz models. Use when the user asks for a sharper, bigger, 4K or "deliverable" version of a clip and the Sloosh tools are connected. Not for changing content (video-extend-edit), captions (captions-subtitles) or audio loudness, muxing and container fixes, which need local ffmpeg (reel-export).

inputs.name: video
inputs.description: finished clip, up to 20 s for the Space

examples: Upscale this clip to 4K
Make the hero loop sharper for the website
Give me a deliverable version of this ad

skills.description: Show a garment, eyewear or jewellery on a person with Sloosh, keeping the person, pose and background and the product's real colour and fit; also move a person into a new pose. Use when the user asks for virtual try-on, "put this on the model", "show it worn", glasses or jewellery on a face, or pose transfer. Not for garment-only shots (ghost-mannequin) or full multi-shot lookbooks (fashion-lookbook-set). Real faces need the person's consent.

inputs.name: pose_reference
inputs.description: any photo whose pose to copy

inputs.name: consent
inputs.description: yes if the person agreed to be used; AI model images are fine

examples: Put this kurta on the model in photo 2, keep her pose
Show these sunglasses on this face
Same model, this necklace, close-up

skills.description: Make a marketplace-compliant white-background product image with Sloosh: product isolated, pure white behind it, filling the frame, no text or props. Use when the user asks for a white background, a cut-out, 'Amazon main image', 'remove the background and put it on white' or marketplace compliance. Not for styled studio packshots with shadows and sets (product-imagery) or the full listing set (amazon-listing-pack).

inputs.name: product_image
inputs.description: the product photo; a plain background and even light work best

inputs.name: strictness
inputs.description: strict (true RGB 255 white via cut-out), or natural (generated white studio with soft shadow)

examples: Put this kettle on a pure white background for Amazon
Cut out the sneaker and give me a clean white version
Make all five of these product photos marketplace-compliant

skills.description: Make truthful, high-contrast YouTube thumbnails and vertical video covers with Sloosh, with a kept face, a 3 to 5 word headline and controlled variants that each test one change. Use when the user asks for a thumbnail, a Shorts cover, a Reel cover or "a cover for this video" and the Sloosh tools are connected. Not for the video itself (product-video) or product listing images (amazon-listing-pack).

inputs.name: face_or_logo
inputs.description: up to three identities or a logo to keep

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: the video's title and the truthful promise it makes

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.description: 16:9 for YouTube, 9:16 for Shorts and Reels covers; defaults to 16:9

examples: Thumbnail for my video: I tested 5 scalp serums for 30 days
Shorts cover with my face and the words WORTH IT?
Three thumbnail variants, same layout, different headline
